---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: ['type:feature']
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem this feature would solve.
What is the use case? Who benefits?

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.
Describe the API, UI, or behavior you envision.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Implementation Ideas

If you have thoughts on how this could be implemented, share them here.
- Which crates would be affected?
- Any breaking changes?
- Migration path for existing users?

## Related Issues/PRs

Link any related issues, PRs, or discussions.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references here.

## Checklist

- [ ] This aligns with the project roadmap (see docs/architecture.md)
- [ ] I have checked for duplicate feature requests
- [ ] I am willing to contribute to the implementation
